_comment: Multi-turn conversation chains used to measure context-awareness.
prime: a fact established in turn 1 (the model must remember it)
follow_ups: list of turns. Each turn has a `query` and an
`expected_keyword` list. The benchmark scores 1.0 if any expected
keyword (case-insensitive) appears in the assistant's response.
We run each chain twice: once WITHOUT memex injection (baseline) and
once WITH it. The delta in accuracy is the 'memex contribution'.
